correctness.rationale: For all integers m>=2, 1<=k<=m and real μ>0, block inversion of A=μI+L gives exactly the Nyström trace residual as tr(A_UU^{-1}). Two center/leaf orbit inverses give E_H and E_L and an affine signed difference with strictly positive denominator. Jacobi complement minors yield the strict D-optimal leaf preference. The append-only ratio follows exactly at budgets one and m. The standalone exact-arithmetic verifier corroborates on all budgets, exact matrix inverses and exhaustive small-star subsets (3557 assertions); finiteness is not used as proof.
